mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, NAME, DEPARTMENT, PASSWORD, STATUS, FAIL_COUNT, PWD_CHG_DATE, LAST_LONG_DATE, REG_DATE, PHONE, EMAIL, PICTURE FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, NAME, DEPARTMENT, PASSWORD, STATUS, FAIL_COUNT, PWD_CHG_DATE, LAST_LONG_DATE, REG_DATE, PHONE, EMAIL, PICTURE ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{name}, #{department}, #{password}, '0', 0, SYSDATE, NULL, SYSDATE, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email}, #{picture} )
mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_CODE, MEMBER_ID FROM MEMBER_ROLE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT DISTINCT M.MEMBER_ID, M.NAME, M.DEPARTMENT, M.STATUS FROM MEMBER M INNER JOIN MEMBER_ROLE MR ON MR.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE MR.ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN' ORDER BY M.NAME, M.MEMBER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_ROLE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_LOG ( LOG_ID, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_STATUS, LOGIN_DATE, MEMBER_ID ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(LOG_ID), 0) + 1 FROM MEMBER_LOG), #{loginIp}, #{loginStatus}, SYSDATE, #{memberId} )
